```{r}
darkTriad <- read_csv("~/Downloads/PSY4802 Notes/darkTriad_Data-1.csv")
```

##worst graph
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(darkTriad, aes(Psychopathy, Narcissism))+ geom_point(shape = 18, color = "#DEDEDE")+geom_smooth(method="lm", color = "#DEDEDE", linetype= "dotted", se = FALSE)+ labs(x= "", y = "") 
```

##best graph
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(darkTriad, aes(Psychopathy, Narcissism)) + geom_violin(fill = "#25452F") + geom_jitter(color="#B472C2", alpha = 0.02) + geom_boxplot(color="black",) + labs(title = "Psychopathy scores by Narcissism Score",
        x = "Psychopathy Scores", y = "Narcissism Scores") +
   theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```


```{r}
ggplot(darkTriad, aes(Narcissism, Psychopathy)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.1, color = "#B472C2") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#25452F") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

cor.test(darkTriad$Narcissism, darkTriad$Psychopathy)
```

### animated plots in R
```{r}
library(gganimate)
library(gapminder)

head(gapminder)

p <- ggplot(
  data = gapminder,
  aes(x = gdpPercap,
      y = lifeExp,
      size = pop,
      colour = country)
) + geom_point(show.legend = FALSE,
               alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  scale_size(range = c(2, 12)) + 
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = "GDP per capita", y="life expectancy")

finalplot<- p +
  transition_time(time = year) +
  labs(title = "Year : {frame time}") +
  shadow_wake(wake_length = 0.1)

anim <- animate(finalplot, renderer = gifski_renderer())
   anim_save("my_animation.gif", anim)
  
```

```{r}
library(gganimate)

head(penguins)

G <- ggplot(
  data = penguins,
  aes(x = bill_len,
      y = body_mass,
      size = bill_dep,
      colour = species)
) + geom_point(show.legend = FALSE,
               alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  scale_size(range = c(2, 12)) + 
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = "Bill Length", y="Bill Depth")

finalplot<- G +
  transition_time(time = year) +
  labs(title = "Year : {frame time}") +
  shadow_wake(wake_length = 0.1)

anim <- animate(finalplot, renderer = gifski_renderer())
   anim_save("my_animation.gif", anim)
  
```

OG graph for what is below without any manipulation
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(darkTriad, aes(Narcissism, Machiavellianism)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = country), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = country), alpha = 0.05)
```
 
#Best Graph Day 2
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)

#Making country a factor
class(darkTriad$country)
darkTriad$country <- as.factor(darkTriad$country)
#clumping groups of countries with less responses to make more readable
TwodarkTriad <- darkTriad %>% mutate(country = fct_lump_min(country, min = 300))
levels(TwodarkTriad$country) <- c("Australia", "Canada", "Great Britain", "United States", "Other", "NA")


Ex <- ggplot(TwodarkTriad, aes(Narcissism, Machiavellianism)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = country), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = country), alpha = 0.05) +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, option = "viridis") +
  scale_color_viridis(discrete = TRUE, option = "viridis")

Ex + facet_wrap(~ country)+theme_classic()+ggtitle(label = "Narcissism and Machiavellianism Grouped by Country")+ xlab("Narcissism Scores")+ylab("Machiavellianism Scores")+theme(legend.position = "none", text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", size=18)) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face="bold"))
```

```{r}
ggsave("NarcissismBest.tiff", width = 10, height = 10, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```
